## About SAPL

Shanker Agencies Private Limited (SAPL) is a 45+ year-old refractory engineering company
headquartered in Delhi, India. Founded in 1980 by **Mohan Taneja**, who has headed the company
since inception, SAPL specializes in high-performance refractory supply, lining design, technical
advisory, and engineering solutions for high-temperature industries. In 2018, **Rahul Taneja**
joined as Director, bringing second-generation leadership and modern sales engineering to the
family business.

SAPL's evolution mirrors India's industrial growth. The company began with local marketing,
supplying general refractories to copper smelters, glass units and small foundries in Delhi NCR.
As India's economy expanded, SAPL shifted focus to steel, cement, aluminium and power plant
customers nationwide, and progressed from general refractories to premium grades to branded
products from the world's leading manufacturers.

## Authorized Brand Partnerships

- **CUMI Super Refractories**: Authorized Dealer (India's largest refractory manufacturer; strategic partner since 2010)
- **Crown Ceramics**: Authorized Dealer (acid proof bricks, tiles, carbon bricks)
- **Divine Cerawool**: Authorized Dealer (ceramic fiber blankets, modules, boards)
- **Mahakoshal Refractories**: Authorized Dealer / Distributor (ramming mass, castables, specialty refractories for steel and foundry)
- **TRL Krosaki (Tata Group)**: Supply Partner (magnesia carbon bricks, basic refractories, silicon carbide)
- **Flow Control Refractories**: slide gate plates, ladle shrouds, sub-entry nozzles, monoblock stoppers, tundish nozzles, well blocks, porous plugs; sourced on order, compatible with IFGL, RHI, Vesuvius and Krosaki gate systems
- **Calderys**: Supply Partner (monolithics, gunning mass, fused cast blocks)
- **Saint-Gobain Performance Ceramics & Refractories**: Supply Partner (HeatKing induction furnace linings and monolithic castables)

## Product Catalog

High Alumina Bricks (AL-45 to AL-90 grades, 40–99% Al2O3) · Fireclay Bricks · Magnesia Carbon

Bricks · Acid Proof Bricks · Insulating Fire Bricks (IFB) · Fused Cast AZS Blocks

## Industries & Applications

- **Steel:** Blast furnaces, BOF/EAF converters, induction furnaces, ladles, tundish, torpedo cars, reheating furnaces, DRI/sponge iron plants
- **Cement:** Rotary kilns, preheaters, calciners, coolers, kiln nose rings, burner pipes
- **Aluminum:** Melting and holding furnaces, casting troughs, pot linings, transfer launders
- **Petrochemical:** Fired heaters, reformers, FCC units, reactor linings, sulphur recovery units
- **Glass:** Melting tanks, regenerators, forehearths, crowns, superstructure
- **Power:** Boilers, FBC units, incinerators, ash hoppers, ducts
- **Foundry:** Induction furnace linings, ladles, runners

## Technical Reference Data (fully cited, matching the source guides on shankeragencies.com)

**High alumina brick grades (IS 8):** AL45 (45% Al₂O₃, max 1500°C) general furnace backup
lining · AL60 (60% Al₂O₃, max 1650°C) cement kiln transition zone, reheating furnaces · AL70
(70% Al₂O₃, max 1700°C) blast furnace bosh, ladle permanent lining · AL80 (80% Al₂O₃, max
1750°C) blast furnace hearth, glass furnace crown · AL90 (90% Al₂O₃, max 1790°C) high-purity
applications and crucibles.
Source: https://www.shankeragencies.com/blog/high-alumina-bricks-specification-guide-al45-to-al90

**LCC vs ULCC castables:** Low cement castables (LCC) contain 4–8% CaO, bulk density
2.7–3.0 g/cc, apparent porosity 8–14%, the workhorse for steel ladle working linings and
tundish covers. Ultra low cement castables (ULCC) contain under 1% CaO, hot MOR 12–18 MPa at
1400°C, specified for ladle impact pads and torpedo car wear zones. Both require disciplined
dry-out (25°C/hr with holds at 110°C, 350°C, 600°C) to avoid explosive spalling.
Source: https://www.shankeragencies.com/blog/refractory-castable-installation-guide-lcc-ulcc-conventional

**MgO-C / magnesia-carbon bricks for BOF and EAF:** 74–90% MgO with 8–20% graphite and
metallic antioxidants (Al, Si, B₄C). Carbon level matched to duty: 8–10% for the metal line and
general lining, 14–18% for the slag line.
Source: https://www.shankeragencies.com/products/shaped-refractories/magnesia-carbon-bricks

**Acid proofing systems:** Acid-proof brick (IS 4860) protects to 300°C; acid-resistant tiles
to 120°C. Potassium-/sodium-silicate cement joints (>96% acid resistance) handle concentrated
H₂SO₄, HCl, HNO₃. Carbon bricks (>90% C) specified for hydrofluoric acid and strong alkalis.
Source: https://www.shankeragencies.com/blog/acid-proof-brick-lining-chemical-plants-guide

**EAF refractories for the green steel transition:** EAF steelmaking is ~30% of global
production today, projected to exceed 50% by 2035 (World Steel Association short range outlook).
India's EAF capacity is expanding at roughly 4–5% CAGR with 20+ million tonnes of announced
capacity by 2030, concentrated in the Odisha–Jharkhand–Chhattisgarh sponge iron corridor.
Source: https://www.shankeragencies.com/blog/eaf-refractories-green-steel-transition

**Refractory consumption benchmark:** Steel production consumes roughly 60–70% of world
refractory output; modern steel plants use about 8–15 kg of refractories per tonne of crude
steel produced.
Source: https://www.shankeragencies.com/blog/what-is-refractory-material
